responsibility: Implements the hand-written target hooks and helper routines for GCC’s M32R backend that complement the declarative machine description in m32r.md. It owns M32R-specific backend behavior for option override and attribute handling, register and calling-convention decisions, return-value and varargs logic, small-data and symbol/section classification, address legitimacy and constant constraints, operand and address printing, function prologue/epilogue and file-start assembly output, scheduler cost/issue hooks, block move and trampoline emission, PIC/register-usage adjustments, and related RTL utilities that consume GCC RTL/tree data and produce target-correct M32R code-generation decisions and assembler text.
same_name_distinction: M32R backend implementation file: unlike m32r.h it contains the executable target-hook and helper function bodies, unlike m32r.md it does not define RTL instruction/scheduling patterns, and unlike m32r.opt it does not declare target switches. It is the code that consumes the configuration and option state from the header/opt files and complements the machine description with C logic for addressing, calling conventions, assembly printing, prologue/epilogue emission, and related target decisions.
